title: "Precomputed results"

Welcome to the ELIXIR-UK RDM Club notebook showcase.

This site presents four Quarto notebooks providing **precomputed results**
as a starting point for discussion focused on different scenarios in each of the breakout rooms.
The notebooks are rendered as part of the site build; readers do not need to run the analyses.

## Notebooks

1. [First-time visitor](notebooks/01-first-time.qmd)
2. [Handed a dataset](notebooks/02-handed-dataset.qmd)
3. [Redistributing data](notebooks/03-redistributing-data.qmd)
4. [Is Bioconductor FAIR?](notebooks/04-is-bioc-fair.qmd)
